resources.title: 2027 HSC Mathematics Advanced — 100-Mark Practice Examination
resources.subtitle: Assessment Task 1 · Challenging original paper
resources.description: An original, challenging HSC-style Mathematics Advanced practice paper designed around an early Year 12 assessment scope. Includes 10 multiple-choice questions and 17 extended-response questions.
resources.subject: Mathematics Advanced
resources.disclaimer: Independent practice paper; not affiliated with NESA or any school. The first uploaded version used the Pri Learning name. It is not an official examination. Access to solutions depends on the attachments currently available on Bored of Studies.
